requests.output:
In base \(b\),

\[
17_b = b+7,\qquad 97_b = 9b+7.
\]

We need \(b+7 \mid 9b+7\). Since

\[
9b+7 = 9(b+7)-56,
\]

this is equivalent to

\[
b+7 \mid 56.
\]

Because \(b>9\), we have \(b+7>16\). The positive divisors of \(56\) greater than \(16\) are \(28\) and \(56\). Thus

\[
b+7=28 \implies b=21,
\]
\[
b+7=56 \implies b=49.
\]

The sum of all such bases is

\[
21+49=70.
\]

\[
\boxed{70}
\]
